description: Fix agent hang, shutdown cleanup, coder_session orphan cleanup, pipeline status guard, and reopen review-recovery

tasks.title: Fix shutdown() to abort all active agents and clear maps
tasks.description: In `agent-runner-service.ts`, update `shutdown()` to iterate over `activeAgents`, call `abortController.abort()` on each (with try/catch), then clear `activeAgents`, `pendingGates`, and `waitingQuestions` maps. Also update `server-daemon` shutdown to call the enhanced `shutdown()`.
acceptanceCriteria: shutdown() iterates activeAgents and calls abortController.abort() for each entry
Each abort is wrapped in try/catch so one failure does not prevent aborting others
activeAgents, pendingGates, and waitingQuestions maps are cleared after abort loop
eventBus.off is still called (existing behavior preserved)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Current shutdown() at line ~100 only does eventBus.off(). No agent abort, no map cleanup.

tasks.title: Inject CoderSessionRepo into AgentRunnerService and clean up orphaned coder_sessions in recoverIssues()
tasks.description: Change the constructor parameter from `_coderSessionRepo?: unknown` to `coderSessionRepo?: CoderSessionRepo` and store as a typed class field. In `recoverIssues()`, after marking an issue as `interrupted`, find all coder_session rows with `status=running` for that issue and update them to `failed`. Also add `executePipeline()` status guard: call `issueRepo.updateStatus(issue.id, IssueStatus.Active)` at the top of the async callback before `pipeline.run()`.
acceptanceCriteria: Constructor stores coderSessionRepo as typed field (not underscore-prefixed unused param)
recoverIssues() calls coderSessionRepo.findByIssueId(issue.id) after setting interrupted
Only coder_session rows with status='running' are updated to 'failed'
executePipeline() calls issueRepo.updateStatus(issue.id, IssueStatus.Active) before pipeline.run()
DB write failure in status guard is caught and logged as warning, does not block execution
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: CoderSessionRepo already has findByIssueId() and updateStatus() methods. No new repo methods needed.

tasks.title: Pass stage into coder_session insert in acp-session.ts
tasks.description: In `acp-session.ts`, pass the `stage` field from `acpOptions.stage` into both `coderSessionRepo.insert()` calls (single-session mode ~line 372 and multi-round mode ~line 772). This makes `hasCompletedCoderSession()` queries by stage work correctly, which is needed for review-recovery detection in T-005.
acceptanceCriteria: Single-session coderSessionRepo.insert() passes stage from acpOptions.stage
Multi-round coderSessionRepo.insert() passes stage from acpOptions.stage
Stage value is optional/undefined-safe (acpOptions.stage may not always be present)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is a prerequisite for T-005 (review-recovery detection uses hasCompletedCoderSession which queries by stage column). Currently stage column is always null in coder_session inserts.

tasks.title: Add 30-minute outer timeout to pipeline execution in executePipeline()
tasks.description: In `executePipeline()` in `agent-runner-service.ts`, wrap the `pipeline.run(issue, acpOptions)` call with a `Promise.race` against a 30-minute timeout. When the timeout fires, call `abortController.abort()` to cancel the underlying SDK calls. The existing `abortPromise` rejection handler will then catch it. Clear the timeout timer on normal completion to avoid leaks. Define `PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000` as a constant.
acceptanceCriteria: pipeline.run() is raced against a 30-minute setTimeout
Timeout fires even if ACI SDK connection.prompt() Promise hangs indefinitely
On timeout, abortController.abort() is called to signal cancellation
Timeout timer is cleared on normal pipeline completion (no timer leak)
Timeout results in pipeline failure path (issue marked as blocked/failed)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The timeout wraps pipeline.run() inside executePipeline(), not individual stage runners. The abortPromise (already exists) handles the AbortController signal rejection.

tasks.title: Add review-recovery shortcut in reopen endpoint for check-stage issues
tasks.description: In `issues.ts` reopen endpoint (`POST /:number/reopen`), after reopening the issue, add review-recovery detection: if issue.stage === 'check' AND `hasCompletedCoderSession(issueId, 'check')` returns true, set `approvalState` to `{ stage: 'check', status: 'awaiting', output: { recovered: true, reason: 'check stage completed, review recovery' }, requestedAt: now }` directly and return early with message 'reopened with approval gate set'. Do NOT call resumePipeline in this path.
acceptanceCriteria: Reopen for check-stage issue with completed coder_session sets approvalState to awaiting directly
Does not call agentRunner.resumePipeline() when review-recovery path is taken
API returns message containing 'reopened with approval gate set'
Reopen for check-stage issue without completed sessions falls through to existing logic
Reopen for non-check stages is unaffected
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Needs issueRepo reference in the reopen handler to call hasCompletedCoderSession(). T-003 must be done first so stage column is populated for new sessions.

No new warnings introduced
All modified files pass typecheck
